notes.title: Wings of the Black Kite
notes.content:
Highlights
Snow Stage: Now features two possible bosses, just like the Jungle Stage. Can you overcome the Black Kite?


Further changes:
Added a new enemy to the Jungle Stage

Reworked the upgrades of all basic cards - each now grants or applies an effect when used

Unique cards can no longer appear in card rewards

Event choices affecting only one player now lock controls to that player

Fixed an issue with the tutorial when accessing the quick map

Updated button behavior: selected buttons now pulsate

Energy progress bar has been reworked and is now integrated directly into the energy icon

Fixed a visual issue with effect icons

Fixed a visual bug when removing the last card of your deck

notes.title: Update notes for September 15th
notes.content:
Fixed a crash issue in the Gamba event
 Fixed text for Restock
 Fixed an issue with Copycat & Absorption
 Fixed Inspect UI for larger resolutions

notes.title: Introducing Chilobrachys
notes.content:
Highlights
The Jungle Stage now features two possible bosses. Players must defeat one of them to advance to the next stage.

Significant improvements to the German translation


Further changes:
Added two new cards: Moat & Transfusion

Updated card art for Charge and Ram

Anticipation now gains multiple repeats instead of increased damage

Fireball retains a cost of 1 when upgraded

Juggle gains additional damage when upgraded

The Greater Ice Spirit has a new move to prevent endless fights

Minions no longer count for Consume and All In

Reduced the chance of receiving upgraded cards as rewards

Dead players can no longer receive block

New animation added for card rewards

Fixed a visual issue affecting the Snowman.



Byeeee

notes.title: Update notes for September 6th
notes.content:
Added Thorn Whip: If your enemies don't want to attack you, just take your thorns to them.
 Buffed Cloak of Darkness, Erase and Bonfire
 Landslide is now an epic card
 Fixed some typos and missing translations

notes.title: Update notes for August 30th
notes.content:
Fixed the upgrade animation in the shop

Adjusted the music during the intro to match the length of each part

Fix files changed by mistake during the last update

notes.title: Update Notes for August 22nd
notes.content:
Changes: 

Added 2 new cards

Sabotage cost 2 → 1

Nari's effect Relentless now increases additively by 20% each time



Behind the scenes we're working on translating the game to German and Japanese.

notes.title: Update Notes for July 15th
notes.content:
Changes:

 Added five new cards. Go try them 
 Fixed a long standing bug where a single remaining player wasn't taking damage sometimes.
 Fixed the Library return bug
 Fixed a bug when displaying the map

notes.title: Update Notes for July 12th
notes.content:
Changes:

 Introducing the inspect feature, which allows you to preview the upgrade of a card.
 Further tutorial extensions
 Fixed Resurrection and Wheel of Time
 Hide duplicate effects in Tooltips

notes.title: Update Notes for July 3rd
notes.content:
Patchnotes

 Fixed file name inconsistencies. Added a fallback for errors when loading sprites.
 Extended tutorial to cover rewards and shop.

notes.title: Tutorial Integration
notes.content:
The tutorial is now integrated into your first run. Instead of a standalone tutorial with a lot of information at once you will now get some information about the game in each fight. This should help new players get started a lot quicker.

Patchnotes

 Integrated tutorial into normal game flow.
 Nari's passive now works on all Attack cards, no matter if you dealt damage with them or not.
 Fixed the animation for gaining and losing block.
 Various small bug fixes.

notes.title: Demo Hotfix
notes.content:
We fixed a critical issue where the demo crashes immediately upon starting.



The Demo can now be played again. Have fun.
